During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' served as an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] often was an adviser to commanders in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. He also fought in battles himself.

==Biography==
{{Quote|We must protect the innocent inhabitants of this system.|the pilot|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''</ref>}}
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] served in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. He also occasionally served on-board [[Starship/Legends|ships]], as he occasionally referred to his [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]. He served during the [[Battle of Fresia]], preparing the team of pilots.

After this point, he began flying an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]]. He often contacted commanders at the beginning of battles, both in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and on the ground, where he would tell them some strategies. He later fought in the [[Defense of Mon Calamari]], defending [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] against a massive imperial naval force. He continued to serve the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|A larger force doesn't always have the advantage. Use tactics to your advantage and remove the enemy position.|the rebel pilot|<ref name="Star Wars: Empire at War" />}}
The pilot believed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was tyrannical, and actively fought against it. He believed that civilians were innocent, and were being oppressed by their government. The pilot had some skill in tactics, and while he didn't command himself, he did give tips to commanders. He believed that tactics were more important than strength and numbers, and urged officers to scout out all routes of attack.

==Behind the scenes==
This pilot appears in a hologram to rebel players in ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]''. He appears again in the expansion, ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''. In it, he shares many lines with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium's]] advisor
